name: Choking First Aid
overview: Choking Emergency Care is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include immediate action can prevent complications; call emergency services for severe presentations. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.

steps.title: Assess responsiveness
steps.description: Ask if they can speak or cough. Severe choking needs immediate action.

steps.title: Back blows
steps.description: For adults/children, give up to 5 firm back blows between shoulder blades.

steps.title: Abdominal thrusts
steps.description: If ineffective, perform up to 5 abdominal thrusts (Heimlich maneuver).

steps.title: Call emergency services
steps.description: Dial 112/102 if obstruction is not cleared quickly.

donts: Do not give water to choking person

faq.question: Can I rely on this choking information instead of a doctor visit?
faq.answer: No. This content supports learning and preparation for conversations with qualified healthcare professionals. It is not a substitute for diagnosis or treatment.

medicalDisclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider.
